SELECT apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END FROM apr50_bookmark WHERE apr50_appr_id = apr01_appr_id AND ( apr50_person_id = #{c.personId} OR apr50_public_yn = 'true' ) ) AS bookmark_yn , apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , apr01_effect_date AS effect_date , f_emp_kor_nm(apr01_reg_emp_id) AS reg_emp_name , dcr01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name , apr01_title AS title , apr01_receive_nm AS receive_name , ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(relateInfo.*) = 0 THEN '' ELSE (CASE WHEN COALESCE(MIN(relate_nm), '') = '' THEN f_get_fund_nm2(MIN(relate_id), apr01_reg_date::date) ELSE MIN(relate_nm) END) || (CASE WHEN COUNT(relateInfo.*) = 1 THEN '' ELSE ' 외 ' || (COUNT(relateInfo.*) - 1) END) END FROM ( SELECT apr03_fund_id relate_id , '' relate_nm FROM apr03_relate_fund WHERE apr03_appr_id = apr01_appr_id UNION ALL SELECT apr12_adv_id relate_id , adv02_manage_nm relate_nm FROM apr12_relate_adv INNER JOIN adv02_account ON adv02_account_id = apr12_adv_id WHERE apr12_appr_id = apr01_appr_id ) relateInfo ) AS relate_display_name , ( CASE WHEN apr01_status_cd = '40' THEN '<' || 'b style=color:#E33E31;' || '>' || f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) || '<' || '/b' || '>' WHEN apr01_status_cd = '99' THEN '<' || 'b style=color:#4B81B9;' || '>' || f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) || '<' || '/b' || '>' ELSE '<' || 'b style=color:#404040;' || '>' || f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) || '<' || '/b' || '>' END ) AS status_name_bold , apr01_note AS note FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree ON dcr01_class_tree_id = apr01_class_tree_id WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY apr01_reg_date DESC, apr01_appr_id DESC LIMIT #{c.limit} OFFSET #{c.offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree ON dcr01_class_tree_id = apr01_class_tree_id WHERE 1=1

WITH fund_count AS ( SELECT apr03_appr_id , MAX(COALESCE(fnd01_r.fnd01_fund_code_id, fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id)) AS fund_id , COUNT(DISTINCT apr03_fund_id) AS fund_cnt , STRING_AGG(COALESCE(fnd01_r.fnd01_fund_cd, fnd01.fnd01_fund_cd), ', ') AS fund_code_all , STRING_AGG(f_get_fund_nm2(COALESCE(fnd01_r.fnd01_fund_code_id, fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id), f_today()::date), ', ') AS fund_name_all FROM apr03_relate_fund INNER JOIN fnd01_fund_code fnd01 ON fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id = apr03_fund_id LEFT JOIN fnd01_fund_code fnd01_r ON fnd01_r.fnd01_fund_code_id = fnd01.fnd01_real_fund_id GROUP BY apr03_appr_id ), adv_count AS ( SELECT apr12_appr_id , MAX(adv02_manage_nm) AS adv_nm , COUNT(DISTINCT apr12_adv_id) AS adv_cnt , STRING_AGG(adv02_manage_cd, ', ') AS adv_code_all , STRING_AGG(adv02_manage_nm, ', ') AS adv_name_all FROM apr12_relate_adv INNER JOIN adv02_account ON adv02_account_id = apr12_adv_id GROUP BY apr12_appr_id ) SELECT apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END FROM apr50_bookmark WHERE apr50_appr_id = apr01_appr_id AND ( apr50_person_id = #{c.personId} OR apr50_public_yn = 'true' ) ) AS bookmark_yn , apr01_title AS title , CASE WHEN COALESCE(fc.fund_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(ac.adv_cnt, 0) = 0 THEN '' ELSE COALESCE(fc.fund_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(ac.adv_cnt, 0) || '건' END AS relate_display_name , ( CASE WHEN apr01_status_cd = '40' THEN '<' || 'b style=color:#E33E31;' || '>' || f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) || '<' || '/b' || '>' WHEN apr01_status_cd = '99' THEN '<' || 'b style=color:#4B81B9;' || '>' || f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) || '<' || '/b' || '>' ELSE '<' || 'b style=color:#404040;' || '>' || f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) || '<' || '/b' || '>' END ) AS status_name , apr01_status_cd AS status_code , apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , apr01_effect_date AS effect_date , f_emp_kor_nm(apr01_reg_emp_id) AS reg_emp_name FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree ON dcr01_class_tree_id = apr01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr10_stamp ON apr10_stamp_id = apr01_stamp_id LEFT OUTER JOIN fund_count fc ON fc.apr03_appr_id = apr01_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN adv_count ac ON ac.apr12_appr_id = apr01_appr_id WHERE 1=1 AND (( ( fc.fund_id IN ( SELECT fnd08_fund_code_id FROM fnd08_org_auth WHERE fnd08_org_code_id = #{c.orgId} AND fnd08_auth_yn = 'true' ) OR fc.fund_id IS NULL ) AND ( 'Y' = CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dcr04_emp_auth WHERE dcr04_class_tree_id = apr01_class_tree_id AND dcr04_person_id = #{c.personId} AND dcr04_retrieve_yn = 'false' ) != 0 THEN 'N' WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dcr03_org_auth WHERE dcr03_class_tree_id = apr01_class_tree_id AND dcr03_org_code_id = #{c.orgId} AND dcr03_retrieve_yn = 'true' ) != 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) AND ( ( apr01_link_cd IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys52_specific_menu_link l WHERE l.sys52_company_id = apr01_company_id AND l.sys52_link_cd = apr01_link_cd ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys52_specific_menu_link l INNER JOIN sys50_specific_menu m ON l.sys52_specific_work_cd = m.sys50_specific_work_cd AND m.sys50_company_id = apr01_company_id INNER JOIN sys51_specific_menu_person p ON p.sys51_specific_menu_id = m.sys50_specific_menu_id AND p.sys51_person_id = #{c.personId} WHERE l.sys52_company_id = apr01_company_id AND l.sys52_link_cd = apr01_link_cd ) ) ) ) OR ( #{c.personId} IN ( SELECT apr04_step_emp_id FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr_id ) ) OR ( #{c.personId} IN ( SELECT apr13_person_id FROM apr13_person_auth WHERE apr13_appr_id = apr01_appr_id ) )) AND apr01_class_tree_id = #{c.classTreeId} AND f_trunc(apr01_reg_date) BETWEEN #{c.startDate} AND #{c.endDate} AND UPPER(CONCAT( f_emp_kor_nm(apr01_reg_emp_id) , f_get_empTrans(apr01_reg_emp_id, apr01_reg_date::date, 'org_code_nm') , apr01_title , fc.fund_code_all , fc.fund_name_all , ac.adv_code_all , ac.adv_name_all )) LIKE UPPER(#{c.searchText}) ORDER BY apr01_reg_date DESC , apr01_appr_id DESC , apr01_title COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" ASC , apr01_status_cd , apr01_effect_date

SELECT CASE WHEN apr03_relate_fund_id IS NULL THEN apr01_appr_id ELSE apr03_relate_fund_id END AS relate_fund_id , apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , apr01_effect_date AS effect_date , emp01_kor_nm AS reg_emp_name , apr01_title AS title FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = apr01_reg_emp_id INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN apr20_relate_ics ON apr20_appr_id = apr01_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr03_relate_fund ON apr01_appr_id = apr03_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr14_relate_ast ON apr01_appr_id = apr14_appr_id WHERE 1=1 AND ( apr03_fund_id IN ( SELECT fnd08_fund_code_id FROM fnd08_org_auth WHERE fnd08_org_code_id = #{c.orgId} AND fnd08_auth_yn = 'true' ) OR apr03_fund_id IS NULL ) AND apr20_class_tree_id = #{c.classTreeId} AND emp01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND f_trunc(apr01_reg_date) BETWEEN f_trunc(#{c.startDate}) AND f_trunc(#{c.endDate}) AND CONCAT( emp01_kor_nm , f_org_nm(emp03_org_code_id, #{c.startDate}) , f_org_nm(emp03_org_code_id, #{c.endDate}) , apr01_title ) LIKE #{c.searchText} ORDER BY apr01_reg_date DESC , apr01_title , apr01_status_cd , apr01_effect_date

SELECT apr03_fund_id AS fund_id , COALESCE(fnd02_r.fnd02_fund_nm, fnd02.fnd02_fund_nm) AS fund_name FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN apr03_relate_fund ON apr03_appr_id = apr01_appr_id INNER JOIN fnd01_fund_code fnd01 ON fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id = apr03_fund_id INNER JOIN fnd02_fund_info fnd02 ON ( fnd02.fnd02_fund_code_id = apr03_fund_id AND fnd02.fnd02_work_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info x WHERE x.fnd02_fund_code_id = apr03_fund_id AND x.fnd02_work_date <= apr01_reg_date ) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN fnd01_fund_code fnd01_r ON fnd01_r.fnd01_fund_code_id = fnd01.fnd01_real_fund_id LEFT OUTER JOIN fnd02_fund_info fnd02_r ON ( fnd02_r.fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01.fnd01_real_fund_id AND fnd02_r.fnd02_work_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info x WHERE x.fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01.fnd01_real_fund_id AND x.fnd02_work_date <= f_today() ) ) WHERE apr01_appr_id = #{apprId}
SELECT apr12_adv_id AS adv_id , adv02_manage_nm AS manage_name FROM apr12_relate_adv a INNER JOIN adv02_account b ON a.apr12_adv_id = b.adv02_account_id WHERE apr12_appr_id = #{apprId}
